title: Great Falls Tribune reports of strange lights that week

tellings.quote: Because we had actually had um newspaper accounts in the Great Falls Tribune

plain: A former Air Force missile officer named Robert Salas says that in 1967, the same week a UFO was reported over his nuclear missile base near Great Falls, Montana, the local paper, the Great Falls Tribune, carried reports of strange lights in the sky. Salas tells this as part of his own account of a UFO he says shut down ten nuclear missiles, and he uses the newspaper reports as a sign that other people saw something too.
